ensemble.name: Multi-Model Sabermetric Blend
ensemble.description: Optimal blend of 4-Factor Starting-Pitcher Elo (35%), Hierarchical Empirical Bayes Talent (25%), Pythagenpat Run-Expectation (20%), and Marcel + Bullpen Fatigue (20%).

variant_bottom_up.name: 4-Factor Starting-Pitcher Elo
variant_bottom_up.description: Team Elo rating adjusted for Home Field (+14.9 Elo), rest/travel, and Tangotiger rolling starter Game Score (4.7 * rGS delta).

variant_rapm.name: Hierarchical Empirical Bayes Talent
variant_rapm.description: Closed-form empirical Bayes partial pooling (Beta-Binomial & Normal-Normal) across park-adjusted batter wOBA/ISO and pitcher xFIP/K%/BB%.

variant_shot_fatigue.name: Pythagenpat Run-Expectation
variant_shot_fatigue.description: David Smyth's variable-exponent run differential baseline ((RS + RA)/G)^0.287 isolating underlying run quality from sequencing luck.

variant_embeddings.name: Marcel 3-Yr & Bullpen Fatigue
variant_embeddings.description: Tom Tango's 5/4/3 age-curved player projections combined with high-leverage relief pitcher cumulative workload & velocity fatigue penalties.
